authors: V. A. Sautenkov, S. A. Saakyan, E. V. Vilshanskaya, D. A. Murashkin, B. B. Zelener, B. V. Zelener
title: Quantum defects in Rydberg nD states of optically cooled 7Li atoms
method: MOT fluorescence-loss spectroscopy, cw UV excitation from 2p 2P3/2
uncertainty: none per level; wavemeter 1e-4 cm^-1, laser linewidth ~1e-3 cm^-1
conversion: Energies from '7Li 2s 2S1/2 hyperfine centre of gravity', energy zero: Eq. (2): En = Euv + EC - Delta + Delta_cg, EC = 2S1/2(F=2)-2P3/2(F=3) [20], Delta = 4e-4 cm^-1, Delta_cg = difference between 2S1/2(F=2) and the ground-state centre of gravity (already applied; its value is not printed in this paper). Eq. (3) En = EI - Rm/(n-mu)^2 is used for the quantum defect mu = 0.00192(17), but the EI value used (fixed or fitted) is not stated; murashkin2016 fits EI = 43487.15692(56) cm^-1 to the same nD levels.
Rows without uncertainty: the laser linewidth of 1e-3 cm^-1 (no per-level values; wavemeter 1e-4 cm^-1).
No J in the source from l = 2 on (fine structure unresolved): j = l + 1/2 assumed (the fine structure of these levels is far below the uncertainties).
caveats: reference constant 14903.98305 differs from zelener2015 (14903.98272) and zelener2016 (14903.98289) for the same scheme; inter-paper offsets of 5-10 MHz
only 5 levels, no uncertainties; 41D value has fewer digits in source
